package.name: moveit2_extended_gpu
package.description:
GPU work, through cuRobo.
Two things earn their place on a GPU here. Batch inverse kinematics, because choosing where to cut a grape cluster means proposing dozens of candidate poses and asking which are reachable -- that is the query shape a GPU is good at, where one IK query is not. And motion planning, which answers with a plain moveit_msgs/RobotTrajectory so a GPU plan is a drop-in for an OMPL one and is judged by the same cable-carrier Behaviors.
cuRobo is Python-only, so it sits behind two services and the Behaviors are thin clients. That also makes the GPU optional at run time: a site without one does not start curobo_service, the Behaviors fail with a clear message, and the Objective's Fallback drops to the CPU path. The Behaviors themselves need neither cuRobo nor a GPU to build or to register.
